import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        whatShouldBeTheLogic(sc);
        sc.close();
    }

    public static void whatShouldBeTheLogic(Scanner sc) {
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        Arrays.sort(a);
        int ma = 0;
        int cnt = 1;

        for (int j = 0; j < n - 1; j++) {
            for (int i = j + 1; i < n; i++) {
                if (a[i] - a[j] <= k) {
                    cnt++;
                } else {
                    ma = Math.max(ma, cnt);
                    cnt = 1;
                }
            }
            ma = Math.max(ma, cnt);
            cnt = 1;
        }
        System.out.println(Math.max(ma, cnt));
    }
}
